2693  static GridTradeRule create(Decimal base_price,
2694  Decimal upper_price,
2695  Decimal lower_price,
2696  GridTrigger trigger,
2697  Decimal quantity,
2698  Decimal upper_quantity,
2699  Decimal lower_quantity,
2700  GridTimeInForce time_in_force)
2701  {
2702  GridTradeRule rule;
2703  rule.submitted_base_price = base_price;
2704  rule.upper_limit_price = upper_price;
2705  rule.lower_limit_price = lower_price;
2706  rule.trigger_quantity = quantity;
2707  rule.upper_limit_quantity = upper_quantity;
2708  rule.lower_limit_quantity = lower_quantity;
2709  rule.time_in_force = time_in_force;
2710  if (trigger.kind == GridTrigger::Kind::Percent) {
2711  rule.trigger_price_type = TriggerPriceType::Percent;
2712  rule.trigger_percent_up = trigger.up;
2713  rule.trigger_percent_down = trigger.down;
2714  } else {
2715  rule.trigger_price_type = TriggerPriceType::Spread;
2716  rule.trigger_spread_up = trigger.up;
2717  rule.trigger_spread_down = trigger.down;
2718  }
2719  return rule;
2720  }
